subject: prd/implement-now
statement: When a pending review obligation has no exact current artifact at its pre-launch read, the executor shall launch at most one bounded sibling reviewer attempt for that obligation in one invocation, assign a fresh attempt identity, and deduplicate concurrent or repeated invocations against the stable obligation identity.
rationale: retries are legitimate across invocations, but duplicate reviewers in one invocation or after a late artifact appears waste spend and race persistence
fit_criterion: duplicate-invocation and replica-lag fixtures produce at most one launch per obligation per invocation, a late exact artifact suppresses a second launch, and each actual retry has one distinct attempt ID joined to the same obligation
